raw_text: Dubai, once the playground of India’s high net-worth elite, is now seeing a very different kind of investor from Bangalore and Indian tech hubs. Salaried professionals and corporate couples are deploying ₹2 crore (around AED 830,000) to buy one-bedroom apartments in Jumeirah Village Circle or Dubai South with rental yields averaging 7–9 per cent, utilizing structured developer payment plans and RBI LRS limits.
platform_context: Times of India feature on middle-class salaried buyers from Bengaluru and Chennai purchasing property in Dubai
